title: The sharp-interface limit of the matrix-valued Allen--Cahn equation
summary: We study the sharp-interface limit of a matrix-valued Allen--Cahn equation with the Saint Venant--Kirchhoff potential \[ F(\mathbf{A})=\frac14\|{\mathbf{A}\mathbf{A}^\top-\mathbf{I}}\|^2 . \] The zero set of this potential is the orthogonal group $\mathbb{O}_n=\mathbb{O}_n^+\cup\mathbb{O}_n^-$, and the corresponding limiting problem combines mean-curvature motion of the interface with harmonic-map heat flow in the two bulk phases.
